notes.title: Royal Duality is now ready to play! Game guide is here!
notes.content:
Royal Duality releases today! 

[b]Game guide[/b]
This visual novel has a few different endings and bonus' to unlock. For those of you who'd like to read a game guide, one is available to view here: [url=https://royalduality2.wixsite.com/discover/post/royal-duality-game-guide-and-unlockables]Game guides and unlockable guide[/url]. It is possible to complete the bonuses in one playthrough with careful choices :)

It is our first release and we are... a little nervous. If you'd like to spare a kind word, please leave us a review. It has been a long journey, with an incredible amount of hard work, dedication and patience, but we're finally here. We'd like to thank our voice talents, our proof-readers, testers, supporters and [b]you[/b] for supporting us on this journey 

[b]So...what's next?[/b]
Royal Duality's Audio Drama, 'The Tales of the Silent One' is in progress and will be released episodically. We hope that those who want to enjoy the story in a different way can listen to it and get a feel for the world that Royal Duality is set in.
There is also another game in the pipeline...if you get to the true ending of Royal Duality...you may just get a taste for what's coming next.
...But for now, we'll take a small rest... Thank you once again, and we sincerely hope you enjoy Royal Duality.

notes.title: Developer Q and A 22/04 at 8PM GMT
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
If you'd like to know a bit more about Royal Duality ahead of release and how we work at Hyakuten Games, come and join us for an [url=https://www.twitch.tv/sazzle04/]informal dev stream on Twitch[/url] at 8PM GMT on 22/04/2022! You can find out more about the creative process of creating Royal Duality, get to know Hyaku and Ten (the game creators) a little better and discover more about the characters and game itself!
 
Thank you once again for your interest in Royal Duality. We are nearly at 100 wishlist adds and we are so grateful for your support so far! We're really excited to release the game and share it with you all.

Thanks again,

Hyakuten Games

notes.title: Milestone reached! 50 Wishlist adds!
notes.content:
We're absolutely delighted to see that 50 people have added 'Royal Duality' to their Steam Wishlists. 
We'd like to say a little 'thank you' to everyone who downloads the game, so you can look forward to finding a free copy of our digital 'player's handbook' available to download. The book will contain character art, backgrounds, information regarding the game's lore and even a handy playthrough guide (for those who don't mind spoilers). 

We'd once again like to thank everyone for adding the game, and we can't wait for you to try it out later in the year! 

From Hyakuten Games
